lines.zh: 我慢慢走，皮下的东西在动。
lines.en: I walk slowly, something shifts under my hide.
Four hooves cross the meadow.
I swish my tail, playing the part.
I lower my head to graze, but don't eat.

lines.zh: 我挑最像牛的那条路走。
lines.en: I take the path that looks most bovine.

lines.zh: 皮下的骨架比牛多一节。
lines.en: One extra joint hides beneath this hide.
I've followed the herd a long way.
I skirt the mud, wary of my hooves.
A bell sways at my neck.
I move slowly, looking placid.
My shadow on the grass looks gentle.
I head toward where the people are.
I chew the air twice.
A fly lands on my back.
I dare not run too fast.
My gait matches a real cow's.
I stand, my eyes not quite blinking.
I look like I only want grass.
This hide fits a little too loose.
I'm counting how many of you there are.

lines.zh: 我反刍的姿势学得很像。
lines.en: I've learned to chew the cud convincingly.
Real cows stand beside me.
While I chew grass, my eyes never blink.
I wear cowhide and pretend to graze.
Head lowered, quite docile.
Grass at my lips, and I don't bite.
A tail flick shoos a fly.
I listen to the herder's calls.
There's a seam in my hide.
The sun dries this hide.

lines.zh: 这身牛皮，等到天黑就脱。
lines.en: This cowhide comes off when it's dark.
This hide is heavy.
Do you smell something off?
I'm just like the other cows.
Don't put your hand on my back.
Would you like to see my teeth?
Have you counted this herd?
I raise my head to you, slowly.
There's salt on your hands.
The pasture is quiet.
You've come early today.
I stand steady, rest easy.
Your look is a little off.
One step closer and I'll lower my head.
The hide is split.
I let out a muffled cry.
Don't lift my hide.
I retreat, acting like a cow.
What's underneath trembles.
A slit in the hide, with no flesh behind it.
I lower my head to guard my neck.
The herd smells blood.
I should go.
You caught a glimpse.
Is that grass?
You're holding wheat.
That smell brings me over.
Lower it, don't hold it up.
I'll eat it for you to see.
Don't pull your hand back. Let me sniff.
Not enough for a herd.
I chew convincingly.
Another handful, please.
Your hands are soft.
My cow tongue reaches the wheat first.
This smells far better than grass.
Only when your palm is up do I come over.
Two bites in, I want more.
This taste makes me forget my act.
Push it a little closer.
You hit this hide of mine.
I didn't move, the hide shifted.
One moo, and I leap at you.
You noticed? No, you didn't.
You bumped a hard bone.
Stand back, cows kick.

My cow tail whips around and cracks your leg.
That nudge doesn't count.
There's a print in the hide now.
I'm only a cow.

lines.zh: 牛群里的那头更适合你。
lines.en: That one in the herd suits you better.
I haven't eaten enough grass.
Such things are done in the pen.
My hide would come off.
Don't touch my neck.
I'm only looking for grass.
Ask again at feeding time.
You're too close.
I'll go stand over there.
A tuft of grass, perfect.
I lower my head and take it.
Wheat dropped on the ground.
I chew twice and swallow.
This tastes a bit odd.
No one's watching, right?
I ate that too fast.
I tuck it by my hoof.
What's on the grass is mine.
I finish it slowly.

lines.zh: 牛皮底下的骨头立起来。
lines.en: Bones rise beneath the cowhide.
I lift a foreleg.
You shouldn't touch a cow's back.
I'm about to leap.
This hide is heavy.
Don't run, it's no use.
This cowhide is still on.

lines.zh: 我一动，你就知道不对了。
lines.en: One move and you'll know something's wrong.
No one in the herd will help you.
I practiced this pose a long time.
I slowly turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我这身牛皮，缝得不太服帖。
lines.en: This cow hide doesn't sit quite right.
Head down, pretending to graze.

lines.zh: 你的影子进我的范围了。
lines.en: Your shadow entered my range.
My chewing pauses for a moment.
The thing beneath has woken.

lines.zh: 铃铛的声音能盖住脚步。
lines.en: The bell covers my footsteps.
Half an arm closer is enough.
Still counting cows?
I keep my breathing steady.
Teeth show beneath the cow's head.
A cow's head hits your chest.
That didn't feel like a cow.
The hide slides off my back.
I bite your shoulder.

Don't shout, the herd will gather.
I've practiced this.

I appear with the herd.

My shadow looks like a cow's.
The herd hasn't noticed me.
I ease into the group.
The bell rings once.
Good grass here.
I stand at the edge of the herd.
The hide singes, the smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，皮都歪了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, hide askew.
Water fills the hide, heavy.
The blast peels half the hide back.
That pierced the hide.
Magic sears beneath the hide.
Too hungry to keep acting.
Lightning strikes, my legs buckle.
No grass to stand on in the void.
